open_points.subject: Customer erasure revision and last-changed instant
open_points.text: “A Customer's last-changed instant moves by: ... erasure” contradicts M04's “the Customer keeps its `customer_ref`, this mark and its instant, and nothing else” and its statement that “its revision” is gone.
open_points.question: When a Customer is erased, does the erasure move and retain its revision/last-changed pair, move it only transiently before discarding it, or remove it without moving it?
options: Retain the incremented revision and last-changed instant on the erased Customer
Increment/update the pair atomically and then discard it
Discard the existing pair without incrementing or updating it
open_points.default_guess: Discard the revision and last-changed instant without moving them, following the more specific erased-Customer facts.

open_points.subject: Audit entries for accepted actions that change nothing
open_points.text: M09 says it records “One significant change of state” and that its listed actions “write an entry”, while State 0 defines accepted unchanged outcomes such as a replayed create, archiving an already archived project, erasing an already erased Customer, and anonymising an already anonymised project.
open_points.question: Does an accepted invocation of an audited action create an AuditEntry when it returns an existing record unchanged, or only when the invocation actually changes state?
options: Write no entry because no significant state change occurred
Write a new accepted entry for every accepted invocation of a listed action
Decide separately for create replays and each idempotent lifecycle action
open_points.default_guess: Write an entry only when state actually changes.
